summary: Convert gender asterisks, colons and Binnen-I in German web text. Local, customizable and free of tracking.
description:
Adjust gendered German spellings. Locally in your browser.

Sprachverstand converts German gender asterisks, gender colons and Binnen-I spellings into conventional German person nouns. You choose how you read: processing takes place locally on your device, and rule groups can be switched on or off individually.

Examples:
• Nutzer:innen → Nutzer
• Mitarbeiter*innen → Mitarbeiter
• NutzerInnen → Nutzer
• jede:r Nutzer:in → jeder Nutzer
• Nutzerinnen und Nutzer → Nutzer
• Student*innen → Studenten
• Studierende → Studenten (controlled by a separate rule group)

Your browser. Your language.

• Reversible immediately: Restore the original text without reloading when you switch the extension off.
• Your preferences: Choose rule groups, exclude websites and add personal exceptions or literal custom replacements.
• Try before saving: Check custom rules with a live preview and conflict hints.
• Dynamic content too: Convert supported spellings in newly loaded text.
• Back up your settings: Export and restore your complete settings locally as JSON.

Optional subtitles and labels

Sprachverstand can process detected subtitles when a website provides them as text. Subtitle processing is off by default. Subtitles embedded in the video image cannot be changed. Accessible labels such as alt, aria-label, aria-description and title can also be processed optionally.

Local and private

Website text is processed entirely locally. Sprachverstand sends it neither to the developer nor to external language services. No external language API, tracking, telemetry or advertising.

Your settings stay on your device by default. You can optionally synchronize explicitly selected settings categories through Firefox Sync. This feature is disabled by default; website text and browsing history are not transmitted through it.

Cautious by design

Feminine nouns without gender markers such as “Professorin” or “Politikerinnen” are preserved. Input fields, editors, source code, URLs and technical data are excluded from regular processing. If a replacement is not sufficiently reliable, the spelling is left unchanged. Missing or incorrect replacements can be reported through the linked GitHub support page.

Sprachverstand adjusts gendered spellings on German websites. It supports Firefox for desktop and Firefox for Android.
